html_source: Photograph taken from the roof of the Custom House showing Butt Bridge in the foreground and Carlisle Bridge in the background. The bridge is closed, and ships are moored on both sides. The Loopline bridge is not visible, so the picture must have been taken before 1891. Source: www.irishtimes.com, courtesy of the National Library of Ireland.
